summary: This clinical study looks at giving the drug tirzepatide to adults who have active psoriatic arthritis, which is a type of joint inflammation linked to skin rashes, along with being overweight or having obesity. The trial is sponsored by Eli Lilly and Company and has a status of Active, not recruiting. A total of 200 participants are taking part in the Phase 4 study. Researchers want to see how well the treatment works over a period of 12 months.
